snippet.title: Lost Twins 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A cute yet challenging puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Test your logic skills by solving clever puzzles to help them find their way back home.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752540/Lost_Twins_2/
